subject: PO field gating, SKU packaging and discount taper for billing cadence
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@horizonretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Trevor Miles <trevor.miles@horizonretail.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: PO fields + billing rhythm — initial ask

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has two gating items before we can route a PO into our AP system:

- Required PO fields (PO number, BU code, cost center, remit entity) that must match the invoice XML.
- An invoice cadence requirement: preferred is monthly consolidated invoices but finance will accept weekly if we can supply a single master PO mapping.

Two questions for your team: will Redwood accept a monthly consolidated invoice against a single master PO (we need line item-level SKU mapping), and is there a way to phase discounts so they align with net-payment timing (we want early-pay discounts to apply only after PO acknowledgement and not at invoice creation)?

We can share a PO template and the AP evidence roster once we agree on format. Opening the thread to see if we can get a one-page checklist to share with our AP.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Horizon Retail
(attachment: Horizon_PO_Template.pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + billing rhythm — initial ask

Hi Marta,

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers up front:

- We can support a single master PO with line-item SKU mapping in the invoice XML. Our finance team can export a mapping manifest that your AP can consume.
- Regarding monthly vs weekly: we can do monthly consolidated invoices, but two implementation details matter: how you want credits/adjustments handled across the month, and whether you need invoice-level PO references for sub-ledgers.
- For early-pay discounts: we can gate discount application to the PO acknowledgement event (i.e., the moment the PO is accepted in our system) rather than invoice generation. That will require a small flag in the PO payload (we typically call it PO_ack_discount=true).

I've attached our standard PO template filled with the fields we usually need. Vanessa — can you confirm if there are any commercial constraints on discount tapering (e.g., apply X% if paid within 10 days, Y% at 30)? Ben — adding you for the pricing side.

Next steps I suggest: 1) Marta to return your PO template with a sample line item; 2) Redwood to provide mapping manifest and a short checklist for AP ingestion; 3) agree on discount windows and test with a pilot invoice.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_PO_Mapping_Example.csv)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + billing rhythm — initial ask

Hi Marta / team,

Quick clarifications from commercial and billing:

- Discount tapering: we can model an early-pay discount that phases down over time (example: 2% if paid within 10 days, 1% within 30 days, 0% at 45+). We implement this as a discount schedule attached to the PO_ack event and then reconcile on payment date. Important: if Horizon prefers discounts to be visible on the invoice but only applied at payment, we can include the scheduled discount lines as informational lines and then post a credit on payment.

- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices are acceptable but Horizon will need to provide a single master PO that owns the monthly ledger. If Horizon's AP requires invoice-level PO references for each sub-entity, we can emit both the master PO and a PO_line_ref per invoice entry.

- Required metadata: please ensure the PO includes: PO_number, BU_code, remit_entity, tax_entity_id, and "PO_ack_discount" boolean. We will provide an example that maps to your Horizon header/line conventions.

Karthik — I'm copying you to confirm there are no legal or invoicing constraints on retaining the discount schedule in the invoice payload (we don't want contractual ambiguity around how credits are issued).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Horizon_Evid_Roster.xlsx)

From: Trevor Miles <trevor.miles@horizonretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@horizonretail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 13:23:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO fields + billing rhythm — initial ask

Vanessa / Jonas — thanks for the quick turnaround.

This aligns with Finance's expectations. A couple of follow-ups:

1) We'll send back a sample master PO with three line items tomorrow. Expect the PO to include our BU_code and remit_entity fields as you described.
2) For discount visibility: Horizon prefers the invoice to show the scheduled discount lines (informational) and for the actual credit to post on payment (so our ERPs can match the settled amount).

If you can provide the mapping manifest and a 1-page AP ingestion checklist by Friday, we can run a small pilot (one master PO, monthly invoice) next billing cycle. If the pilot looks good, we'll discuss committing to a quarterly consolidated lane and the discount slab for a committed volume.

Appreciate it — Trevor
Treasurer, Horizon Retail
